name: Côte d'Ivoire (ITS 2024 reform, RICF, IRVM, CNPS)

registry_correction: CI: ITS (single tax since the 2024 reform, Ord. 2023-719) with the RICF; main statute = CGI as amended by Ord. 2023-719 and the LF 2025 annex.
headline: Côte d'Ivoire 2025 built from the DGI's online CGI (2024 ITS reform, Ord. 2023-719) and the 2025 fiscal annex: monthly 0-32 % on gross pay less a fixed family reduction (RICF, 5 500 F per half-part a month), 17 % on dividends, CNPS 6,3 %; the CNPS minimum base makes the first franc of pay cost 45 360 F a year, and the CNPS page's ceiling contradicts its own SMIG.
